meta.name: Heweliusz
meta.description: After a catastrophic ferry disaster, the off-duty captain seeks answers and justice for those who lost their lives — and those they left behind.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When a ferry capsizes and sinks in a ferocious storm, the ship's off-duty captain is pressed for answers even while rescue efforts are still underway.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: To avoid liability, company officials shift blame to Capt. Ułasiewicz. Plagued by nightmares and guilt, Witold tries to make sense of what happened.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Pursued by company and state officials, Witold is pressured to support their narrative. Jolanta has trouble finding a lawyer to represent her.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As the trial begins in earnest, the true extent of the cover-up dawns on Piotr. Mrs. Kaczkowska receives a tempting offer — but it comes at a cost.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: With evidence in hand that could break the case against Capt. Ułasiewicz, Piotr races against time to present it at the trial.
